description: This file manages environment variable overrides for skills in the openclaw project, including tracking, sanitizing, applying, and reverting environment variable changes related to skill configurations.

methods.name: getActiveSkillEnvKeys
methods.description: Returns a set of environment variable keys currently injected by skill overrides.

methods.name: applySkillEnvOverrides
methods.description: Applies environment variable overrides for a list of skills based on their configurations.

methods.name: applySkillEnvOverridesFromSnapshot
methods.description: Applies environment variable overrides based on a snapshot of skills.
